quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool summary report: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Half of FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026): net sales ¥27,055 million (+48.3% YoY), operating profit ¥7,595 million (+81.4%), ordinary profit ¥8,034 million (+109.4%), profit attributable to owners of parent ¥5,962 million (+108.7%); both net sales and operating profit reached record highs for a first half. The company cites higher sales of high-quality products plus lower production costs from expanded capacity and higher utilization rates.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales ¥27,055 million (+48.3%); operating profit ¥7,595 million (+81.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool summary report: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Half of FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: demand for data centers, particularly AI servers, increased significantly, driven by hyperscalers' expanded AI infrastructure investment. In Asia excluding Japan, demand for package substrates for data center servers and high-layer-count PCBs continued to grow, mainly in China and Taiwan; Asia net sales ¥17,626 million (+63.2%), operating profit ¥3,048 million (+131.5%). In Japan, to meet generative-AI-related demand, the company expanded production capacity by launching a satellite plant and reviewing factory layouts; Japan net sales ¥17,287 million (+41.5%), operating profit ¥4,477 million (+101.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: Asia ex-Japan net sales ¥17,626 million (+63.2%); Japan net sales ¥17,287 million (+41.5%)
